title: Add Abracapture theme accessibility and About experience
description:
Create the Abracapture visual theme with accessibility support and an About page with product identity. Integrate both into the main application shell via Main.qml.

Before editing, inspect:
- qml/Main.qml for existing navigation structure, page loader, and import patterns
- qml/theme/ for any existing theme or style files
- qml/pages/ for existing page patterns and conventions
- Any existing About or version information in the project

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
1. Create qml/theme/AbracaptureTheme.qml as a singleton providing color palette (primary, secondary, background, surface, text, error, capture-active, capture-idle), font size scale factor, high-contrast mode toggle, and spacing constants. Support a dark and light variant selectable at runtime. Ensure capture-state indicator colors meet WCAG AA contrast ratios against their backgrounds.
2. Create qml/pages/AboutPage.qml showing application name (Abracapture), version, brief description, license, and build information. Include attribution for PipeWire, Qt, libsndfile, libFLAC, and ffmpeg. Ensure the page is keyboard-navigable.
3. Modify qml/Main.qml to:
   - Import and apply AbracaptureTheme
   - Add navigation entries for RecordingsPage and AboutPage
   - Ensure all existing page navigation and keyboard operation is preserved
   - Apply theme colors to the application shell

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: qml/theme/AbracaptureTheme.qml exists and provides color palette, font scale, high-contrast toggle, and dark/light variants
Capture-state indicator colors (capture-active, capture-idle) are defined in the theme
qml/pages/AboutPage.qml exists and displays application name, version, description, license, and build info
AboutPage.qml includes attribution for PipeWire, Qt, libsndfile, libFLAC, and ffmpeg
qml/Main.qml imports AbracaptureTheme and adds navigation entries for RecordingsPage and AboutPage
Existing page navigation in Main.qml is preserved after modifications
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: choose specific color values for theme palette
choose layout and typography for About page
choose navigation entry labels and icons
